selection: same frozen historical primary model, train-target ranking from prior atlas; no feature selection from new TEST results
prototypes: 2 highest positive B cells per 4 TRAIN donors;4 per historical TEST donor;3 nearest same-donor B cells with zero target SAE activation; no fallback
attribution: original minus single reference-value replacement activation; fixed gene tokens and bins, no raw-count renormalization; include actual TopK and preTopK encoder; own SAE-selected prototypes, embedding/PCA controls descriptive
aggregation: reference equal, then prototype equal, then donor equal; missing input genes contribute zero, conditional mean and coverage separately
genes: positive TRAIN scores; all-input top40 and remove RPL/RPS then reselect top40; same background prefix removal
pathways: GO BP/Reactome/Hallmark MSigDB2025.1.Hs;5..500 members in actually TRAIN-covered background; retain unannotated background genes; ORA upper hypergeom
null: 10000 random without-replacement sets per list, joint mean raw-count quintiles/detection quintiles from all TRAIN B cells and token coverage1-2/3-5/6-8; selected remain eligible; save full precision bins and draws
multiplicity: global BH across BOTH features x BOTH analyses x all3databases, separately ORA/MC-matched; within-feature BH is secondary
exact_sensitivity: predeclared exact stratum-hypergeom convolution; not replacement for primary MC p; separate global BH; diagnose finite MonteCarlo resolution, retains coarse-bin assumptions
test: no gene/pathway selection using TEST; attribution-ranked versus expression-difference and10 joint-bin matched random deletion orders on selected TEST prototypes; descriptive one donor, not independent causal evidence
interpretation: model-input sensitivity and annotation association only; no pathway activation or causal program claim
